title: Habib tum par salam e hussain
body:
Habib tum par salam e hussain
Habib tum par salam e hussain..(4)
Chale aao karbobala..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Akela hua hai hussain
<<MINI>>
Habib tum par salam e hussain..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Mere habib, ay mere dost, ay meri aankho ke chayn
Habib tum par..(2)
1. Rajab me madine se nikla tha mai
mohabbat thi jisse wo ghar chhod kar
mai sehta raha sakhtiya'n ay habib
rasool e khuda sheher chhod kar
<<MINI>>
chale aao karbobala...
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Bohot mukhtasar sa hai lashkar mera
muqabil to mere hai laakho adu
wafadar bhi ho bahadur bhi ho
nazar dhundhti hai tumhe chaar su
<<MINI>>
chale aao karbobala...
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Mere khoo'n ke pyase hai ye ehle sharr
mere qatl ki hai ye tayyariya'n
laeeno ki teghe bhi  hai muntazir
tumhari zarurat hai mujhko yahan
<<MINI>>
chale aao karbobala...
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Abhi mera maqtal saja bh nahi magar mujhpe roti hai karbobala
meri bekasi ka hai jo marsiya
agar sunna chaho to ay hamnawa
<<MINI>>
chale aao karbobala...
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Ye tehreer padhte hi nikle habib to rahwaar roka sare karbala
kiya aake sheh ko salam e wafa
habib e hazi se ye sheh ne kaha
<<MINI>>
acha kiya habib tum yaha aagaye
<<DIVIDER>>
mere habib, ay mere dost, ay meri ankho ke chayn
6. Ye dekho  ye dekho sitam
kahan mere khaime kahan alqama
jo dil par hai guzri sunaunga mai
jo tum aa gaye to dilasa mila
<<MINI>>
acha kiya habib tum yaha aagaye
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Ye mazhar, ye irfan, ye matami
hai tarteeb me karwaan e aza
ye sab hai habib e shahe mashraqain
sare hashr bolenge shahe huda
<<MINI>>
Habib tum par salam e hussain..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
